summary: This bill establishes a national data system to collect information on public safety officer suicides, authorizes grants for peer-support mental health programs for fire departments, emergency medical services, and healthcare providers, and directs the development of resources and best practices for treating mental health issues in these professions.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on improving mental health services and support for public safety officers and healthcare providers, including data collection on suicide incidence, peer-support programs, and resources for treating PTSD. This directly relates to the provision of healthcare services, specifically mental healthcare, for specific populations.
